[[Focus of the Master]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[The Master]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Cathedral of Flames]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Soul Reaping]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Bleached Skull]], [[dye]]d white.
